records.recipe_note: 2026-08-05: BLOCKED on every transport. censys.com now returns HTTP 403 to the direct browser-UA fetch AND relays an upstream block/challenge through the jina reader, on the feed (https://censys.com/feed/), the blog index (/blog, /resources/blog/) and even /sitemap.xml — so the whole origin is challenge-gated, not one path. The legacy www.censys.io/blog/rss.xml returns 404. The documented feed recipe is therefore dead until the origin relaxes. Set fetch_method=blocked so source_health.py classes this handled rather than re-flagging it every run; status stays ACTIVE because a 403 is a transport block, never a content-death signal. Re-probe the feed each run and restore fetch_method=rss the mo
